Resolves #21359

Supersedes #22007 · Related: #21358, #21140, #21932

Renews `examples/functional/button/base` and `examples/functional/nestedComponents` off `dev` per [Vega's post-18:00 UTC handoff](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21359#issuecomment-7068957569) and [Grace's review handover](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22007#issuecomment-7085033717), retaining `@joshuaallgaier2-cmd`'s commit (`7ef1c5b6e784` → `26830b42e4e1`) and adding the reactive `badgeText` click handler (`0 → 1 → 2` synced with the Inspector `badgeText` field) plus E2E assertions and `1440×900` / `390×844` frames.

- **Heading scheme (`nestedComponents`, item 2):** `1, 2, 2.1, 3` (`1 · Functional root`, `2 · Classic container`, `2.1 · Functional child through the classic container`, `3 · Direct functional child`) reflects the ownership tree—`2.1` is rendered inside `RelayContainer` (`2`), whereas `3` is a direct sibling under the functional root—while the intro now names the `Inspector`.
- **`NestedComponentsNL.spec.mjs` changes (`AC-3`):** (1) the existing `nestedComponents` test now asserts the `"in the Inspector"` intro sentence and the `1 / 2 / 2.1 / 3` heading sequence in DOM order; (2) a second Neural Link test navigates `/examples/functional/button/base/index.html` (registering `examples/functional/button/base/app.mjs` in `e2eSpecReach`), verifies the button rests inside `.neo-workbench-stage` at `1440×900` and `390×844`, and clicks twice to verify `badgeText` advances `'0' → '1' → '2'` across App Worker state, the Inspector `badgeText` field, and `.neo-button-badge` DOM with `0` console/page errors.

Evidence: L4 (Chromium whitebox E2E + live HTTP 1440×900 & 390×844 light/dark frame captures, 0 console/page errors) → L4 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5).

## Deltas from ticket
- Synced the Inspector `badgeText` `TextField` on button click (`me.down({labelText: 'badgeText'})`) so the stage badge, Inspector input, and `CodeView` stay consistent after clicks, and fell back via `Number.parseInt(..., 10) || 0` so non-numeric edits never produce `'NaN'`.
- Removed the stale `MainContainer#onConfigRecordChange` shadow in `examples/functional/button/base/MainContainer.mjs` so `ConfigurationViewport#onConfigRecordChange` tracks `ui` changes in `CodeView` and URL hash.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; local `check-fixed-sleeps`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-class-module-scope`, `check-examples-body-only`, and `E2eCiSelection` / `E2eSpecReach` / `externalBrainSelection` unit specs (`56/56`) passed.

Frame critique: All 12 captures ran with `0` console/page errors. On `button/base`, removing `marginTop: 500px` / `marginBottom: 1500px` brings the button from off-screen (mobile) / bottom-offset with overlapping `"Badge"` pill (desktop) into the center of `.neo-workbench-stage` with synchronized `badgeText: '2'` across stage, Inspector, and `CODE`. Shared workbench/theme items flagged by the cold readers—fixed `280px` mobile `.neo-workbench-stage` height in `ConfigurationViewport.css:194` leaving `nestedComponents` sections `1–3` below the initial scroll fold while the Inspector has spare height above `CODE`, right-edge clipping on `Neo.examples.functional.nestedComponents.Component` in `.neo-workbench-stage-subtitle` / `CODE`, partial scroll-edge clipping of `iconCls` at `390×844`, and `ConfigurationViewport#classifyControl` grouping `Value` / `rippleEffectDuration` under `SIZES`—belong to `examples/ConfigurationViewport.{mjs,css}`, which `AC-5` explicitly bars this PR from modifying (`out of scope, noted in defect-note MESSAGE:c19aa4b9-843c-4bc8-8f89-12382d47082f`, fingerprint `101584cae7cfa303`).

Verified at `775134612f`. `26830b42e4` keeps Joshua as its author. The handler parses `badgeText` (`|| 0` guards a non-numeric edit) and sets the reactive config. In the frames, the button on `dev` sits 500 px down with the badge over its label; at head it is centered and counting.
